habitat_zh: 早寒武世近海底教学复原
claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired teaching art using basic recognizable form, not strict scientific reconstruction; no exact species/measurement/locomotion/coexistence claim.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original living whole-organism interpretation: elongated flattened soft mantle and sole, one cap shell near each end, ordered overlapping dorsal armour and short marginal sclerites. Simplified counts and muted green-grey shell colors are artistic choices, not measured fossil evidence. Molluscan-inspired classification is retained; no reptile identity, exact phylogenetic conclusion, mouthparts, locomotor mechanism or microstructure claimed. Closed armour roots intentionally overlap the continuous mantle.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创全身生活复原：长扁软体背部与腹足、前后两端各一枚帽壳、有序叠片背甲和短边缘骨片。简化数量及柔和灰绿色配色为美术设定，非化石测量。保留软体动物启发分类，不当作爬行类，不主张精确系统位置、口器、运动机制或微观结构。封闭骨片根部有意嵌入连续外套体。

name.zh: Halkieria 双壳鳞甲软体爬行动物

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish elongated flattened body with front and rear cap shells joined by tiled sclerites in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以长扁体前后各具帽壳，中间覆盖叠片骨片搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。
